About.title: Hi, I'm Tomas Arras
About.description: A passionate web developer specialized in creating solutions on both the frontend and backend. I am a techie and have the skills to translate ideas into code to create digital and functional experiences.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.description: My toolbox is full of programming languages, frameworks and modern technologies. From frontend with React, Vue, Bootstrap, Tailwind to backend with Spring, Laravel, ExpressJS, I am equipped to tackle a variety of challenging projects.
